written_before: any DEV-20 score of the two arms below was computed

control.state: the shipped v6 DEV-20 submission with eval.gsr_score.vote_track_attributes applied on ('role','team','jersey') -- the W3 shipping candidate

why_these_arms.stage1: results/gsr_benchmark/gsr_v9_w4_oracles.json -- the goalkeeper bucket (29 tracks whose role is right and team wrong + 13 tracks that are keepers we call players) is worth +3.0190 GS-DetA on track-level relabel, the largest reachable sub-bucket; contaminated tracks (111) are worth only +0.3365 and cannot be relabelled at all.
why_these_arms.mechanism: GSR left/right is the half a team DEFENDS and a keeper stands in the goal he defends, so his side is the sign of his own pitch x. Kit clustering is ANTI-informative for keepers (GSR_TEAMSIDE.md section 6: a keeper lands in his own team's cluster in 24.4% of rows).

arms.name: gk_side
arms.rule: every track whose majority role is 'goalkeeper' gets team = 'left' if median(bbox_pitch.x_bottom_middle) < 0 else 'right'
arms.gt_free: reads only our own predictions (role label + projected pitch x); no Labels-GameState.json
arms.prior_support: gk_self is 113/113 on dev GT (results/GSR_TEAMSIDE.md section 3) and 79/79 keeper identities on GSR-TRAIN GT (this session)

arms.name: gk_side_role
arms.rule: first, on each half of the pitch (sign of a track's median x) that carries NO goalkeeper track, relabel to 'goalkeeper' the player track with the largest median |x| among those with median |x| >= GK_MIN_ABSX_M and penalty-area frame share >= GK_MIN_PEN_FRAC; then apply gk_side to every goalkeeper track
arms.fit_on: GSR-TRAIN ground truth ONLY (57 sequences, 79 keeper and 1145 player identities): the most-extreme-per-side rule scores 67 TP / 1 FP / 12 FN at these thresholds. No DEV score was consulted.
arms.structural_prior: at most one keeper per half of the pitch (a rule of football, not a fitted parameter)

gates.deta: the shipped combination must add >= +0.75 GS-DetA on top of the voted control
gates.hota: pooled GS-HOTA not worse than the control
gates.paired: per-sequence GS-HOTA helped > hurt with Wilcoxon p < 0.05 (n = 20)
gates.subpopulation: any arm that loses DetA on a sub-population it touches is reported as a qualifier, not hidden (the W3 treatment of role-only voting)

noise_floor: exactly 0 -- both arms are deterministic pure functions of the submission JSON; the GPU artifacts are byte-identical to the control's
splits: DEV-20 only; TEST-38, test-49 and challenge are not read in this session
